items.question: To meet increased customer demand just before the holiday, salesclerks had to work ---- more hours than usual.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“significantly”代入题干后为“To meet increased customer demand just before the holiday, salesclerks had to work significantly more hours than usual.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：D（significantly）。
